profiles.name: Iskandar Dzulkarnain Abdul Khalid
profiles.description: Iskandar Dzulkarnain Abdul Khalid represents Kuala Kangsar, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. An independent MP supporting the government under the reported confidence-and-supply agreement.
profiles.affiliation_note: Independent government support is distinct from membership of a political party. The 29 October agreement does not prove any subsequent parliamentary vote.
